assumptions.en: All-in equity runs every board to five cards regardless of dominance; ties split the pot and are credited 0.5 to each side.
assumptions.zh: 全下胜率一律发满五张公共牌，不论是否已被 dominate；平局分池，两边各记 0.5。

assumptions.en: Two players, two hole cards each, no blinds, antes or rake: a cell is a share of the pot, not an expected value in bb.
assumptions.zh: 两人各两张手牌，不计盲注结构、前注与抽水：这里的数字是底池份额，不是以 bb 计的期望值。

assumptions.en: Card removal is exact within a board: a combo holding a board card is excluded, and two combos sharing a card are never dealt together.
assumptions.zh: 同一张牌面内牌张排除是精确的：含牌面牌的组合被剔除，互相共享手牌的组合永不发出。

assumptions.en: Batches draw from distinct RNG streams (the seed advances per batch), which is what makes the reported standard error measured rather than assumed.
assumptions.zh: 各批次取自互不相同的随机数流（种子按批递增），报告的标准差因此是量出来的，不是公式猜的。

note.en: Sampled in the board only, not in the traversal (adr/0007). The per-batch panels are not committed, so range-level (weighted) numbers cannot be recomputed from this file -- a generator run emits them as their own artifacts.
note.zh: 只抽样公共牌，不抽样遍历（adr/0007）。逐批面板未提交，所以范围级（加权求和）的数字无法从本文件重算，必须由生成器同一次运行产出为独立产物。

sampler.en: 20,000 five-card boards drawn uniformly (each board is the five lowest of 52 random keys); for every board, all dealable ordered (hero, villain) combo pairs are enumerated and compared -- no shared card, no combo holding a board card. Nothing is sampled at the deal level.
sampler.zh: 抽 20,000 张五人公共牌面（每张牌面把 52 个随机键排序取最小的五个）；对每张牌面，枚举并比较全部可发的 (hero, villain) 有序组合对——既不共享手牌，也不含牌面上的牌。发牌层面不做任何抽样。

title.en: Preflop all-in equity by class (169 x 169), sampled over 20,000 boards
title.zh: 翻前全下胜率矩阵（169 x 169 类别），基于 20,000 张公共牌抽样

claim.en: All 28,561 ordered cells agree with exhaustive enumeration within their declared standard errors.
claim.zh: 全部 28,561 个有序格都在各自声明的误差棒内与穷举枚举一致。

path_to_verified.en: Add exact marquee cells to the slow tier of tests/test_preflop.py, or raise that test's board budget to this artifact's own.
path_to_verified.zh: 在 tests/test_preflop.py 的 slow 层增加精确旗舰格，或把该测试的抽样预算提到与本产物同级。

why_unverified.en: Three cells have been enumerated exactly (AA v KK, AKo v QQ, 72o v 22, at 142-178 s each). The rest are held by identities -- zero-sum, diagonal, populated -- and the closed-form denominator, not by a per-cell exact reference.
why_unverified.zh: 只有三格做过穷举枚举（AA v KK、AKo v QQ、72o v 22，实测各 142-178 秒）。其余格由零和、对角、全填充与闭式分母这些恒等式兜住，但没有逐格的精确对照。
